title: Local embeddings benchmark: MiniLM vs Nomic

parts: Write notes comparing local embeddings for technical chat archives where the team wanted better grounding without upgrading the model.

Local embeddings benchmark: MiniLM vs Nomic. MiniLM stayed faster and lighter for incremental indexing, while Nomic retrieved slightly richer technical matches when the query was vague. For reducing hallucinations without using a larger model, the deciding factor was not raw model size but whether the embedding space kept benchmark notes, postmortems, and thread summaries close together enough for the retriever to hand the generator grounded evidence.
